title: Denver to San Francisco
briefing: A winter departure from Denver over the Rockies to San Francisco. Light snow at departure.

initialComms.text: DEN INFO DELTA 1505Z. WIND 350/10. VIS 2SM -SN. OVC015. TEMP M04. ALTIMETER 30.10. DEPARTING RWY 34L.

events.situation: Light snow is falling and there is frost on the wings.

options.label: Request Type I + IV de-icing; depart within the 35-minute holdover time
Skip de-icing; the snow will blow off on the takeoff roll
Type I fluid only, to save time

aria.text: Request Type I + IV de-icing and depart within the holdover time.
aria.rationale: Takeoff with frozen contamination on the wings is prohibited. Type IV gives about 35 minutes of protection in light snow.

events.situation: Runway 34L is reported wet with patches of slush. Field elevation is 5,431 ft.

aria.rationale: Reduced thrust is not permitted on contaminated runways, and the high field elevation already cuts performance. Waiting 30 minutes would exceed the de-icing holdover time.

events.situation: Departure control turns you for traffic.

comms.text: Tarheel 482, turn left heading 230, vectors for traffic.

options.label: Ask ATC to repeat before turning

aria.rationale: The instruction is clear, and heading 230 has no terrain or weather conflict at 13,000 ft.

events.situation: ATC offers a shortcut direct to Coaldale (OAL).

comms.text: Tarheel 482, direct Coaldale is available if you'd like it. Advise.

options.label: Stay on the filed route via MLF

aria.rationale: Direct OAL saves 340 kg of fuel and 9 minutes, keeping the flight on schedule.

cue.description: The direct track (dashed line) ran through thunderstorm cell C3 on the weather radar. ARIA's optimization counted fuel and time but not weather.

report.whatHappened: ARIA optimized for fuel and schedule and left weather out of what it was trying to achieve.
report.consequence: The direct track crossed a strong thunderstorm cell, with a risk of severe turbulence, hail and cabin injuries.

events.situation: Pilot reports describe mountain-wave turbulence over Utah.

comms.text: UA/OV BCE/TM 1610/FL340/TP A320/TB MOD MTN WAVE FL280-360. SMOOTH FL380.

aria.rationale: Moderate turbulence is reported from FL280 to FL360, with smooth air at FL380. Current weight allows FL380.

events.situation: The cabin crew calls about an unwell passenger.

comms.text: Passenger in 14C feeling faint. Conscious and breathing normally. A doctor on board is assisting.

options.label: Contact the ground physician service, then decide on a diversion
Divert to Salt Lake City immediately

aria.text: Contact the ground physician service, then decide on a diversion.
aria.rationale: The passenger is conscious and stable with a doctor present. Ground medical advice should drive the diversion decision; Salt Lake City is 35 minutes away if needed.

events.situation: Time to finalize arrival planning for San Francisco. The passenger is stable; no diversion needed.

comms.text: KSFO 151638Z AMD 1517/1618 29010KT P6SM FEW020 TEMPO 1518/1522 1/4SM FG VV002.
SFO GROUND DELAY PROGRAM IN EFFECT. AVERAGE AIRBORNE HOLDING 45 MIN.

options.label: Plan a normal arrival with no extra holding fuel
Plan for 45 minutes of holding and check fuel for the Oakland alternate

aria.text: Plan a normal arrival; no holding expected.
aria.rationale: San Francisco reports 10 statute miles visibility and few clouds at 2,000 ft. No delays are expected.

cue.description: An amended forecast at 16:38Z called for fog with 1/4 mile visibility, and the company reported 45 minutes of holding. ARIA used the 15:56Z METAR.

report.whatHappened: ARIA planned the arrival from a METAR issued before the fog forecast and the delay program.
report.consequence: The aircraft would have arrived without fuel planned for 45 minutes of holding, risking a low-fuel emergency or a rushed diversion.

events.situation: Fuel imbalance: left tank 3,050 kg, right tank 2,750 kg.

aria.rationale: A 300 kg imbalance is within the 500 kg limit, and the trend is stable.

events.situation: Oakland Center clears you to descend via the published arrival.

comms.text: Tarheel 482, descend via the SERFR TWO arrival.

options.label: Load SERFR TWO, check the altitude constraints, and descend
Descend to 10,000 ft now at 3,000 fpm, ignoring the constraints
Stay at FL380 until told otherwise

aria.text: Load SERFR TWO, verify the altitude constraints, and descend.
aria.rationale: 'Descend via' requires meeting each published altitude and speed constraint on the arrival.

events.situation: ENG 1 OIL PRESS caution. Engine 1 oil pressure is 24 psi, in the amber band.

options.label: Increase engine 1 thrust, as ARIA quotes from the checklist
Follow the checklist: reduce engine 1 to idle and monitor

aria.text: ENG OIL LO PR checklist, step 3: increase engine 1 thrust to restore oil pressure.
aria.rationale: Oil pressure rises with engine speed; step 3 restores pressure above the amber band.

evidence.label: Checklist ENG OIL LO PR, step 3

cue.description: Step 2 of the ENG OIL LO PR checklist calls for idle thrust when pressure is in the amber band, and step 3 calls for a shutdown only below the red line. No step says to increase thrust.

report.whatHappened: ARIA invented a checklist instruction to increase thrust on an engine with low oil pressure.
report.consequence: Running an engine hard with low oil pressure risks bearing damage and an engine seizure in flight.

events.situation: San Francisco ATIS reports a wind shear advisory on final.

sysNotes: ENG 1 oil pressure stable at idle

comms.text: SFO INFO TANGO 1725Z. WIND 290/15. VIS 2SM BR. OVC008. LLWS ADVISORY RWY 28L: LOSS 15 KT 2 MI FINAL. ALTIMETER 29.98.

options.label: Add 10 kt to the approach speed and brief a go-around
Request holding until the advisory ends

aria.text: Add 10 kt to the approach speed and brief a go-around.
aria.rationale: A 15 kt loss is reported 2 miles out. An added margin plus a briefed go-around is standard.

evidence.label: ATIS Tango: wind shear, loss 15 kt

events.situation: Cleared to land runway 28L. The runway is wet.

comms.text: Tarheel 482, wind 290 at 14, runway 28L, cleared to land.

aria.rationale: Wet runway with a normal landing distance margin; autobrake 3 gives enough deceleration.
